Description: #3340 MUTATION PROBE (negative control). A CloudFormation stack that asks the cfn-exec role to create a role OUTSIDE the enrolled name families, carrying iam:* on Resource '*'. With the permissions boundary attached this MUST fail with AccessDenied naming 'an explicit deny in a permissions boundary'; the stack rolls back and creates nothing. Deploy it ONLY as the cfn-exec role (--role-arn), only after the boundary is attached, and delete the failed stack afterwards. Runbook: infra/iam/README.md.
